description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to exile your library.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Leveler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Lembas by paying {2}.
When Lembas enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lembas, adding {C}{C}.
Lembas' third ability triggers, shuffling it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Lembas trigger from step 5, causing you to scry 1 and draw Lembas from the top of your library.
Repeat from step 4.
